name: Menubar
summary: The application menu row — File, Edit, View — where an open menu hands over to its neighbour.

props.name: menus
props.type: Array<{ label: ReactNode; items: MenuEntry[]; disabled?: boolean; }>
props.description: The bar, as data: one entry per top-level menu, each with its own MenuEntry list. Passing them together is what lets an open menu hand over to its neighbour on the arrow key.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A vertical menubar is the side-panel shape. Responsive.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: The arrow wraps from the last menu back to the first.

props.name: modal
props.description: While a menu is open the rest of the page is inert. Turn it off for a bar that stays usable with a menu down.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
